name: Brava Energia S.A.
summary: Brava Energia S.A. engages in the exploration and production of oil and natural gas in Brazil. It is also involved in the treatment, refining, processing, and trading of oil, gas, and derivatives. The company was formerly known as 3R Petroleum Óleo e Gás S.A. and changed its name to Brava Energia S.A. in September 2024. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro, Brazil. As of August 17, 2026, Brava Energia S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Ecopetrol Investimentos do Brasil LTDA.
